synopsis: Chapter 7 cites Li et al. at CVPR 2024 for documenting an open-loop failure mode in systems that act [f5244]. Chapter 8 cites two Li et al. papers from 2016 and a related lateral-stability paper from 2013 for articulated-wheel-loader models using 7 and 8 degrees of freedom, Fiala tire models and active braking, with roll instability treated as the critical mode [f6032]. The loader models were validated against a scaled wheel loader and then applied to a ZL50 machine; active braking was modeled as an influence on wheel-loader roll [f6033, f6290]. The supplied facts establish separate contributions to testing methodology and machine dynamics, but do not establish that the CVPR authors and the loader-model authors are the same people or directly connect their findings [f5244, f6032, f6033, f6290].

relations.note: Adds scaled-loader validation and subsequent ZL50 application to the multibody modeling description.
Specifies active braking's modeled influence on wheel-loader roll.
